values.eml_summary: Lifts asymmetry from edge weight to effective time scale: nodes carry stability, decay, tension, impact and local valid time, so refresh is triggered locally instead of by one global clock.
values.eml_summary_zh: 把非對稱性從邊權重提升到有效時間尺度：節點帶有穩定性、衰減、張力、影響度與局部有效時間，刷新由局部觸發而非單一全域時鐘。
